participation.context: Chose one sheet, paid, and did not ask its name.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You paid a penny and folded the sheet into the pack. You left the tune to be heard later.

title: Bought a ballad-sheet for a penny

description: One bench, and no second man

participation.context: Stood in the lantern, answered, and took the bench.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You answered for yourself and not for a company of men. You let the knot stand as a lodging-knot. You bit your lip at his galleys and did not give him the number you knew. You stayed.

title: Took one bench

participation.context: attendee in The staff, and the legs
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You stayed on the bench. The staff stayed against the wall.

title: Sat where the staff was propped
